as the ice-cooled Swede Bjorn Borg faced the volatile New Yorker John McEnroe.
Borg was playing in his fifth consecutive Wimbledon final, having won the previous four.
Still only 24 years of age, he dropped only two sets en route to the final, while McEnroe had conceded three.
McEnroe was just 21 years old and playing in his first Wimbledon singles final.
